name: Russian Bauman Flag Left Restored Hotfix
changes: Restored the flag list as a small left-side panel for Review.
Restored the flag list as a small left-side panel for Exam.
Removed horizontal flag tray placement from the active Review/Exam render paths.
Kept the right side as the main question/content panel.
Added V13.00 CSS overrides to prevent the previous single-column layout from hiding the left flag rail.
Added responsive fallback: on narrow screens, the left rail stacks above content with its own scroll area.
important_note: This hotfix restores the old standard behavior requested by the user: flags as a small left-side panel, main question content on the right. It does not restore the earlier broken hidden sidebar behavior; the left flag rail now has fixed scroll limits and responsive fallback.
